assertions.assertion: Calls AddJwtBearer with Authority set to 'https://identity.example.com'

assertions.rationale: options.Audience = "api1" is set inside the AddJwtBearer lambda.

assertions.assertion: Sets TokenValidationParameters.ValidTypes to include 'at+jwt' to prevent JWT confusion attacks
assertions.rationale: options.TokenValidationParameters.ValidTypes = ["at+jwt"] is present, with an explanatory comment about JWT confusion attacks.

assertions.assertion: Includes UseAuthentication() before UseAuthorization() in the middleware pipeline
assertions.rationale: app.UseAuthentication() is placed immediately before app.UseAuthorization().
Provides the dotnet add package command and a PackageReference for Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer.
